content:
**Added inline per-line code-review capability to v2 audit**

What: Added a new capability gap to the v2 merge audit (section 4): the reviewer should post inline per-line code-review comments, not just a PR-level verdict body.
Current state (verified in code): review/poster.mjs renders one brain-review/1 verdict and posts it via prReviewComment; github.mjs:373 does POST /pulls/{n}/reviews with {body, event:'COMMENT'} — body only, NO comments[] array. Findings cite file:line in prose but are not anchored to the diff.
Wanted: when the reviewer doesn't understand something or requests a change, emit it as an inline comment anchored to path:line, bundled INTO the same review, so the dev sees the code review on the diff lines in the PR + a PR-level summary comment linking it.
Changes needed (grounded): (1) brain-review/2 schema carries comments[] {path,line,side,body,kind:question|change-request}; (2) prReviewComment accepts optional comments and forwards to reviews API — GitHub same call, GitLab needs POST /merge_requests/{iid}/discussions with position (real provider-parity work); (3) evaluators emit anchored findings not just global verdict; (4) extend anti-loop/anti-stale + deny-set idempotency to inline comments (don't re-post each run); (5) STAYS event:'COMMENT' per ADR-0020 — never APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES, reviewer is never a merge authorizer, so change-request is advisory comment not blocking state.
Placement: evolution of reviewer v2 (#284), a Track H slice — candidate for its own issue once direction ratified. NOT yet ticketed (user asked only to add to report).
Next (user's stated plan): general scan of brain + installation scan, goal = a serious product.
Where: brain/scripts/review/poster.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs:373, brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs (4 COMMENT-only verbs), adr-0020. Report: docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md section 4. Related: [[architecture/v2-merge-audit]] [[architecture/sdd-role-neutrality]].
